name: CelesTrak Request Builder Nodes
description: Request-builder flow nodes for CelesTrak ingest (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64). gp / satcat / spw / eop / socrates turn a TimerTick into the hostcap/http-request HttpRequest(s) of their lanes; each request's CONTEXT carries the parser's job as ONE size-prefixed SDS $ICN record (Ingest Connector: endpoint, target standard and emitted standards, provider and source name, upstream origin celestrak.org / CelesTrak, dataset gp-full-catalog / satcat / satcat-csv / sw-all / eop-all / socrates-minrange / socrates-maxprob, and the origin's usage terms - the usage-policy sentence quoted verbatim, https://celestrak.org/usage-policy.php, citation). hostcap/http-request echoes CONTEXT in its HttpResponse, so celestrak-parser reads its job from the response it parses: no job port, nothing paired by position. Every request carries the lane's response byte budget as MAX_BYTES (the host errors past it, never truncates: gp 67108864, satcat 33554432, spw 4194304, eop 4194304, socrates 8388608). publish_request turns a stored batch's IngestResult plus the parser's IngestRequest into the dataset-publication POST for the node's loopback admin endpoint (§19), its BODY one IngestResult FlatBuffer, emitting nothing when celestrak_publish_url is unset or the batch was refused. cache_warm turns a stored batch's IngestResult into the dataset's default-query $FSO control frame for hostcap/flatsql-query. Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (an SDS $PIV hostcall answering one ModuleConfig FlatBuffer on raw "config"): celestrak_gp_url, celestrak_satcat_url, celestrak_satcat_csv_url, celestrak_space_weather_url, celestrak_eop_url, celestrak_socrates_minrange_url, celestrak_socrates_maxprob_url, celestrak_http_timeout_ms, celestrak_provider_id, celestrak_gp_max_bytes, celestrak_satcat_max_bytes, celestrak_spw_max_bytes, celestrak_eop_max_bytes, celestrak_socrates_max_bytes, celestrak_license, celestrak_license_url, celestrak_citation, celestrak_publish_url, celestrak_cache_sql, celestrak_cache_max_rows - never via host code. No capabilities: plugin.getConfig is a builtin.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one tick (or one result/meta pair) into its request frames in one pass after one config read; no state survives an invocation, no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: Builds the GP full-catalog fetch (its parse job in CONTEXT) from a timer tick. BATCHING: every input port is single-stream by contract and ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind up to 64 frames; maxStreams is declarative): a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK) from the flow's timer trigger; its fields are not read.

HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET (node CONFIG celestrak_gp_url), TIMEOUT_MS celestrak_http_timeout_ms (90000), MAX_BYTES 67108864 (celestrak_gp_max_bytes) (the host errors past it, never truncates); CONTEXT the parser job, ONE size-prefixed $ICN record: CONNECTOR_ID/SOURCE_NAME celestrak-gp, KIND HttpsPull, HTTP_METHOD GET, ENDPOINT_URL the URL, TARGET_SCHEMA OMM.fbs, EMITS_SCHEMAS [OMM, MPE], POST_INGEST_ACTION Archive, ORIGIN_ID celestrak.org, ORIGIN_NAME CelesTrak, DATASET_ID gp-full-catalog, PROVIDER_ID (celestrak_provider_id), LICENSE (the usage-policy sentence quoted verbatim, celestrak_license), LICENSE_URL, CITATION.

methods.description: A stored batch's IngestResult + the parser's IngestRequest (the only carrier of provider/source) -> one dataset-publication POST to celestrak_publish_url (the node's loopback admin endpoint), its BODY one IngestResult (INGR) naming the batch: SCHEMA and BATCH_ID from the result (the request's when the result lacks them), PROVIDER_ID and SOURCE_NAME from the request, the counts. Fail-closed: nothing when celestrak_publish_url is unset, nothing for a REFUSED batch; an incomplete identity is refused (incomplete-publication-identity). BATCHING: every input port is single-stream by contract and ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind up to 64 frames; maxStreams is declarative): a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (module-sdk runtime type INGR) from hostcap/storage-ingest.
IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) the parser authored for the batch (SCHEMA, TAGS provider/source/batch).

HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: POST celestrak_publish_url, content-type application/octet-stream, BODY one IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch, TIMEOUT_MS celestrak_http_timeout_ms.

methods.description: A stored batch's IngestResult -> ONE $FSO QUERY_RECORDS control frame for hostcap/flatsql-query:query (graph task sdn-dataset-default-query-materialized-cache): QUERY = celestrak_cache_sql (default "SELECT data FROM sds_omm ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT ?"), one bound i64 parameter = celestrak_cache_max_rows (default 5000) in FlatSQL's tagged encoding; a caller value is never interpolated into the SQL. BATCHING: every input port is single-stream by contract and ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind up to 64 frames; maxStreams is declarative): a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (module-sdk runtime type INGR) from hostcap/storage-ingest.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $FSO (FlatSQL node control): OPERATION QUERY_RECORDS, QUERY the SQL bytes, PARAMETERS [tag 2][u32le 8][i64 LE], PARAMETER_COUNT 1.
